result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers are almost the same: both right-align money in tabular lining figures, use exactly three font sizes, and make Total due bold at 1.25rem. B has better semantics (row-scoped th in the footer) and a heavier rule above the total, but these don't outweigh A's small typographic advantages. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers right-align the money in tabular lining figures, use two decimals throughout, and use only three type sizes. B's headers are quieter (0.75rem, muted gray), and it greys out the subtotal and tax and right-aligns their labels next to the amounts, so Total due stands out more. A's heavier rule above the total is a nice touch, but its left-aligned footer labels sit far from their amounts.
